purpose: Define validation across containment, relation, ownership, authority and dependency dimensions, including semantic-owner uniqueness and composition consistency.

topics.name: Structure and Ownership Validation
topics.purpose: Define validation across containment, relation, ownership, authority and dependency dimensions, including semantic-owner uniqueness and composition consistency.

semantics.separation_rule: Each structural edge is validated in its own dimension and is never inferred from another dimension.
semantics.ownership_rule: Every machine-significant owned semantic surface resolves to an authoritative owner.
semantics.relation_rule: Relation uses conform to explicit relation definitions/endpoints/cardinality where applicable.
semantics.authority_rule: Authority is never inferred from ownership, containment or Topic membership.
semantics.dependency_rule: Required dependencies resolve and missing dependencies are never silently enabled.
semantics.composition_rule: Domain/Universal Module/Meta compositions reference owned semantics instead of duplicating them.

invariants.rule: Validation proves or rejects conformance; it never invents missing semantics or becomes semantic owner.

hard_gates.condition: relation use lacks valid relation definition
